camel_example: aliyun servicemesh DescribeServiceMeshes --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key test --Tag.1.Value yahaha --force
description_en: Queries a list of service meshes
kebab_example: aliyun servicemesh describe-service-meshes --tag Value=yahaha Key=test --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeServiceMeshes

ServiceMeshes.description_en: The details of the service meshes

ClusterSpec.description_en:
The instance type of the Service Mesh instance. Valid values:

`standard`: Standard Edition.

`enterprise`: Enterprise Edition.

`ultimate`: Ultimate Edition
ClusterSpec.description_zh:
服务网格实例规格，取值：

`standard`：标准版。

`enterprise`：企业版。

`ultimate`：旗舰版

IntranetApiServerEndpoint.description_en: The internal endpoint of the API server

IntranetPilotEndpoint.description_en: The internal endpoint of Istio Pilot

PublicApiServerEndpoint.description_en: The public endpoint of the API server

PublicPilotEndpoint.description_en: The public endpoint of the Istio Pilot for the mesh instance

ReverseTunnelEndpoint.description_en: The endpoint of the reverse tunnel. This parameter is deprecated

OwnerId.description_en: The ID of the cloud service instance that created the mesh
OwnerId.description_zh: 创建网格的云产品实例ID

OwnerType.description_en:
The type of the cloud service that created the mesh. Valid values:

`ackone`: The mesh is created by ACK One.

If this parameter is empty, the mesh is created by a user
OwnerType.description_zh:
创建网格的云产品类型，取值：
`ackone`：网格由ACK One创建。

当此项取值为空时，代表网格由用户创建

ServiceMeshInfo.description_en: The basic information about the service mesh

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the service mesh was created

Name.description_en: The name of the service mesh

Profile.description_en:
The edition of the service mesh instance before commercialization. Valid values:

`Pro`: Professional Edition.

`Default`: Standard Edition
Profile.description_zh:
商业化之前的网格实例规格，取值：

`Pro`：专业版。

`Default`：标准版

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the service mesh resides

State.description_en: The status of the service mesh

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the service mesh was last modified
UpdateTime.description_zh: 服务网格最后修改时间

Version.description_en: The version of the service mesh

ApiServerLoadbalancerId.description_en: The ID of the Server Load Balancer instance that is used to expose the API server
ApiServerLoadbalancerId.description_zh: 公网地址暴露API Server对应的负载均衡ID

ApiServerPublicEip.description_en:
Indicates whether to expose the API server to the internet. Valid values:

`true`: The API server is exposed to the internet.

`false`: The API server is not exposed to the internet
ApiServerPublicEip.description_zh:
是否使用公网地址暴露API Server，取值：

`true`：使用公网地址暴露API Server。

`false`：不使用公网地址暴露API Server

PilotPublicEip.description_en:
Indicates whether to expose Istio Pilot to the internet. Valid values:

`true`: Istio Pilot is exposed to the internet.

`false`: Istio Pilot is not exposed to the internet
PilotPublicEip.description_zh:
是否使用公网地址暴露Istio Pilot，取值：

`true`：使用公网地址暴露Istio Pilot。

`false`：不使用公网地址暴露Istio Pilot

PilotPublicLoadbalancerId.description_en: The ID of the Server Load Balancer instance that is used to expose Istio Pilot
PilotPublicLoadbalancerId.description_zh: 公网地址暴露Istio Pilot对应的负载均衡ID

MeshConfig.description_en: The configurations of the service mesh

ExtraConfiguration.description_en: The extended configurations of the Service Mesh instance
ExtraConfiguration.description_zh: 服务网格实例的扩展配置

Playground.description_en: The configurations of the ASM lab. This parameter is valid only for ASM lab instances
Playground.description_zh: ASM实验室配置（仅对ASM实验室实例有效）

Scene.description_en: The ID of the ASM lab scenario

Mtls.description_en:
Indicates whether to enable locality load balancing. Valid values:

`true`: Locality load balancing is enabled.

`false`: Locality load balancing is not enabled
Mtls.description_zh:
是否启用服务就近访问，取值：

`true`：启用服务就近访问。

`false`：不启用服务就近访问

OutboundTrafficPolicy.description_en:
The outbound traffic policy. Valid values:

`ALLOW_ANY`: allows access to services outside the mesh.

`REGISTRY_ONLY`: allows access to only services that are registered in the mesh
OutboundTrafficPolicy.description_zh:
外部流量策略，取值：

`ALLOW_ANY`：允许访问网格外的服务。

`REGISTRY_ONLY`：仅允许访问网格内的服务

Http10Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether to enable HTTP 1.0. Valid values:

`true`: HTTP 1.0 is supported.

`false`: HTTP 1.0 is not supported
Http10Enabled.description_zh:
是否启用支持HTTP 1.0。取值：

`true`：支持HTTP 1.0。

`false`：不支持HTTP 1.0

TraceSampling.description_en: The sample rate for Tracing Analysis
TraceSampling.description_zh: 启用链路追踪时的采样率

SidecarInjector.description_en: The configurations of the sidecar injector

AutoInjectionPolicyEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether to enable automatic sidecar injection using pod annotations
AutoInjectionPolicyEnabled.description_zh: 通过Pod Annotations实现自动注入

EnableNamespacesByDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether to enable automatic sidecar injection for all namespaces.

`true`: Automatic sidecar injection is enabled for all namespaces.

`false`: Automatic sidecar injection is not enabled for all namespaces
EnableNamespacesByDefault.description_zh:
是否为所有命名空间开启自动注入功能。

`true`：为全部命名空间开启自动注入。

`false`：不为全部命名空间开启自动注入

InitCNIConfiguration.description_en: The configurations of Container Network Interface (CNI) initialization

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the istio-init container has privileged permissions for traffic redirection to istio-proxy. Valid values:

`true`: The istio-init container does not have privileged permissions.

`false`: The istio-init container has privileged permissions
Enabled.description_zh:
为istio-proxy进行流量重定向时，是否需要赋予istio-init容器特权，取值：

`true`：不需要赋予istio-init容器特权。

`false`：需要赋予istio-init容器特权

ExcludeNamespaces.description_en: The namespaces that are excluded from the Istio pod check
ExcludeNamespaces.description_zh: 要从Istio Pod检查中排除的名称空间

Telemetry.description_en:
Indicates whether to enable Prometheus to collect metrics. (Managed Service for Prometheus is recommended.) Valid values:

`true`: Prometheus is enabled to collect metrics.

`false`: Prometheus is not enabled to collect metrics
Telemetry.description_zh:
是否开启采集Prometheus 监控指标（建议使用阿里云Prometheus监控），取值：

`true`：开启采集Prometheus 监控指标。

`false`：不开启采集Prometheus 监控指标

Tracing.description_en:
Indicates whether to enable Tracing Analysis. To enable this feature, activate Managed Service for OpenTelemetry. Valid values:

`true`: Tracing Analysis is enabled.

`false`: Tracing Analysis is not enabled
Tracing.description_zh:
是否启用链路追踪（需要开通可观测链路OpenTelemetry版），取值：

`true`：启用链路追踪。

`false`：不启用链路追踪

Network.description_en: The network configurations of the service mesh
Network.description_zh: 服务网格网络配置信息

VSwitches.description_en: The list of virtual switch IDs

items.description_en: The list of virtual switch IDs

Upgradable.description_en: Indicates whether the mesh can be upgraded
